newsitem.title: FRANCE: French govt to be named later on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: French govt to be named later on Wednesday.

text.p: The new Socialist-led government will be named later on Wednesday, a senior aide to Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said on Wednesday.
"Today", said Manuel Valls, media adviser in Jospin's office said when asked when the government would be named.
Earlier, sources in the Socialist party said the government would be presented on Wednesday or "at the latest" on Thursday morning.
